verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunk copy of the portrait layout, centred in the banner: the headline is tiny, the cats are a small cluster, and both side thirds are empty purple, so it doesn't suit the banner shape at all. B rearranges it properly, with a large headline on the left and the cats on the right reading left to right; its only flaws are the cats crowding the right edge and bottom with almost no margin, and a slightly tight headline margin.
